text: Consistency check, bare body redone: Nick saw fur tufts at the horn base in the bare-body views (and the bare front was nearly the furred front). The three bare views are now a hairless gray clay sculpture: no fur or tufts, the horn rising directly from a smooth skull, the ears as thin smooth shells, the haunches, long hind feet and forelegs readable. They match the furred views' proportions and pose; the clay tail reads as a smooth knob. The earlier bare views are retired. The other contradictions listed in the first check still stand for the blockout.
